extracted.intended_audience: regulatory analysts, agency staff, and public stakeholders tracking federal regulatory actions and notice-and-comment activity
extracted.subtask_description: Using a RegInfo.gov dashboard to view and filter currently pending regulatory actions by several classification dimensions (rule stage, review length, economic significance, international impact) and to see total pending actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Pending Actions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed as a summary metric on the dashboard indicating the current count of pending regulatory actions. No further guidance provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: By Rule Stage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A dashboard view/filter that categorizes pending actions according to their stage in the rulemaking process (e.g., proposed rule, final rule). The page provides no additional explanatory text.

rubrics_metrics.name: By Length of Review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A dashboard view/filter that groups pending actions by how long their review period is or has been. No examples or scoring guidance shown on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: By Economic Significance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A dashboard view/filter that classifies pending actions by their assessed economic significance. The page does not define significance thresholds or provide further explanation.

rubrics_metrics.name: By International Impact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A dashboard view/filter that identifies pending actions with international implications. No further details or criteria are provided on this page.
